stage0015_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「So, $$コンロイ$$?
　Learn anything about this thing?」

stage0015_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「I'm no specialist myself,
　so I can't analyze it fully...」

stage0015_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「This white machine...
　it's clearly no ordinary mobile suit.」

stage0015_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Whatever you've got is fine.
　Report what you found.」

stage0015_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「This mobile suit's name is $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.
　Built by Anaheim under the Vist Foundation,
　it seems core to a project called the UC Plan.」

stage0015_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「UC...
　$$宇宙世紀$$, or short for Unicorn...」

stage0015_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「This unit uses a Psycoframe throughout its body,
　which aids the psycommu so the pilot's brainwaves
　feed directly into the drive system.」

stage0015_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Meaning it can be controlled
　by thought alone...」

stage0015_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Though only a registered pilot
　can activate that function.」

stage0015_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「So only that unconscious boy, then...
　What about the transformation system in the report?」

stage0015_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「That looks like a system called
　the NT-D in an activated state.」

stage0015_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「I can't say for sure.
　Its activation conditions are also locked behind
　heavy protection, so it's unclear.」

stage0015_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Either way, this unit is a mass of secrets.
　That Anaheim bigwig's goal is almost
　certainly this thing.」

stage0015_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Anaheim Electronics' board of directors
　included Vist Foundation blood, didn't it...」

stage0015_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Yes... $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$...
　Younger sister of $$カーディアス$$, head of the Vists.」

stage0015_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「And that man $$アルベルト$$'s surname is Vist too.」

stage0015_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「And that Anaheim tried to seize this unit
　from the Vist Foundation head by force...
　This reeks worse and worse.」

stage0015_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Commander $$ダグザ$$!
　Do not touch that unit without permission!」

stage0015_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...Mr. $$アルベルト$$, please face the facts.
　Depending on how things go, this unit may
　have to join the fighting too.」

stage0015_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This ship is being chased by Neo Zeon.
　More firepower to intercept them can't hurt.」

stage0015_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「The infirmary!
　The boy who piloted the Unicorn woke up!」

stage0015_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Aboard an Earth Federation warship.
　You're safe, so don't worry.」

stage0015_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ハサン$$
「I'm $$ハサン$$, this ship's doctor.
　I checked your belongings to confirm your identity.
　...You're $$バナージ・リンクス$$, correct?」

stage0015_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ハサン$$
「Your life isn't in danger, at least.
　You likely blacked out because your body
　couldn't take that white suit's hard g's.」

stage0015_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$シン$$
「That was something...
　You basically saved the colony out there.」

stage0015_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$バナージ$$
「! What happened to Industrial 7!?」

stage0015_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It took real damage, it seems,
　but it's somehow still running.」

stage0015_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シン$$
「Wait a sec...!
　We're already a good distance
　away from Industrial 7!」

stage0015_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$シン$$
「Why? Because we're being chased by Neo Zeon.」

stage0015_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not fair...!
　Bringing me here without asking me...!」

stage0015_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm sorry about that.
　But please understand it was an emergency.」

stage0015_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I felt I could trust this person.
　I'm not sure why, myself...」

stage0015_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
Kamille
「Thanks.
　I'm $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

stage0015_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And this one sulking over here
　is $$シン・アスカ$$.」

stage0015_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$シン$$
「Just so you know, it was me
　covering you out there.」

stage0015_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シン$$
「Huh, you can be honest after all.」

stage0015_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Sorry.
　But I have to get back
　to Industrial 7.」

stage0015_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$バナージ$$
「There's someone I have to protect.」

stage0015_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Someone you have to protect...」

stage0015_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is it, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

stage0015_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$リディ$$
「The civilian I rescued turned out to be
　a student at the Anaheim tech school too,
　same as your guy here. Brought her for an ID check.」

stage0015_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ミコット$$... and $$タクヤ$$ too!」

stage0015_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「I'm floored!
　No way it was you piloting
　that white mobile suit!」

stage0015_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$オードリー$$
「But I'm glad you're safe...」

stage0015_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミコット$$
「You know this girl, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0015_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シン$$
「Huh... so this is the one
　you meant, the one you have to protect...」

stage0015_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The Unicorn was entrusted to me
　for that very reason.」

stage0015_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Unicorn...
　So that's the Gundam's name...」

stage0015_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$オードリー$$
（The mobile suit the Vist Foundation kept hidden...
　That's the key to Laplace's Box...）

stage0015_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$リディ$$
「You seemed awfully concerned about
　that mobile suit. Are you a student at
　the Anaheim tech school too?」

stage0015_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
Riddhe
「Come to think of it, I never introduced myself.
　I'm $$リディ・マーセナス$$... I'm a pilot.」

stage0015_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Seriously, $$バナージ$$...
　where'd you meet such a cute girl?」

stage0015_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...More importantly, $$カミーユ$$...
　what happens to $$タクヤ$$ and the others now?」

stage0015_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Once things settle down, I think they'll be
　dropped off at some colony to head home
　to Industrial 7.」

stage0015_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Excuse me.
　You're the boy who piloted that mobile suit?」

stage0015_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'll be questioning him now.
　Everyone but Doctor $$ハサン$$, please step out.」

stage0015_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$シン$$
（He's got some real presence, but who is he?）

stage0015_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Commander of the special forces unit $$エコーズ$$.
　He's under the command of that Anaheim man now.）

stage0015_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シン$$
（That Anaheim guy... you mean that one...）

stage0015_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's the situation, gentlemen.
　Kindly clear out at once.」

stage0015_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is Mr. $$アルベルト$$ sitting in on the questioning too?」

stage0015_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Of course.
　That mobile suit belongs to Anaheim.」

stage0015_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'll say this now: be ready for what comes.
　As a civilian, you used a military
　mobile suit and stepped into combat.」

stage0015_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This is a grave crime, punishable even by death.」

stage0015_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But the Unicorn...
　he's the one who entrusted it to me!」

stage0015_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That person...!?
　Don't tell me... $$カーディアス・ビスト$$!?」

stage0015_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Hard to believe.
　That $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ would entrust that
　to a boy like you...」

stage0015_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Did he leave any last words for you?」

stage0015_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Save everyone...
　That's all he said.」

stage0015_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...That person is my father.」

stage0015_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...If I said so, would that convince you?」

stage0015_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「You...! Are you mocking me!?」

stage0015_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Attention, all hands.
　Small craft detected on our course.」

stage0015_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「As a precaution, man your posts
　and prepare for an emergency.」

stage0015_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Did Neo Zeon get ahead of us...!?」

stage0015_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「You saved us, Captain.
　Our shuttle ran into some trouble.」

stage0015_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$オットー$$
「No, sir... Even if by chance,
　it was fortunate you crossed our path.」

stage0015_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Here I thought it was terrorists,
　and it was just a shuttle in distress...」

stage0015_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$n
「And I'm surprised that a Federation
　official was aboard as well.」

stage0015_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$エマ$$
「That's Deputy Chief of Staff
　$$アデナウアー・パラヤ$$. He was headed to a
　military drill ceremony at an L3 colony.」

stage0015_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Then why not just travel by warship?
　Why take a civilian shuttle instead...」

stage0015_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You... a passenger on the shuttle?」

stage0015_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
Quess
「That's right.
　I'm $$クェス・パラヤ$$.
　$$アデナウアー・パラヤ$$'s daughter, over there.」

stage0015_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Come on, $$クェス$$!
　You can't just leave the room like that...!」

stage0015_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$クェス$$
「Ha ha, Has is such a serious one.」

stage0015_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カツ$$
「Hathaway...!
　You're $$ハサウェイ・ノア$$!?」

stage0015_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did he say Noa...? Don't tell me...」

stage0015_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カツ$$
「Just what you're thinking.
　This is Captain $$ブライト$$'s son.」

stage0015_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
Hathaway
「I'm $$ハサウェイ・ノア$$.
　It sounds like my father's indebted to you.」

stage0015_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$ and I met a few times on Earth.」

stage0015_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$シン$$
「Huh... didn't know Captain $$ブライト$$
　had a kid this grown up.」

stage0015_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$n
「Captain $$ブライト$$, the Londo Bell commander?」

stage0015_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah, that's him.
　In the $$ＵＣＷ$$, we fought the $$多元戦争$$
　under Captain $$ブライト$$'s command.」

stage0015_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$クェス$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$ knows more people than I thought.」

stage0015_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「It's just that my dad's amazing.」

stage0015_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$クェス$$
「But $$ハサウェイ$$'s dad sounds so cool.
　Commanding people who get it like this.」

stage0015_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$クェス$$
「The opposite of my own dad, I mean.
　Sensitive, delicate, and strong people.」

stage0015_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Yeah...
　Mr. $$アデナウアー$$ meant to bring $$クェス$$ along
　and have her ride the warship, but...」

stage0015_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$ threw a fit at the last minute
　and refused to go, so she ended up on a
　civilian shuttle, that's where we met.」

stage0015_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カツ$$
「Why were you on the shuttle, $$ハサウェイ$$?」

stage0015_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「My dad's taking part in the L3 drill,
　so he invited me along.」

stage0015_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I think he wanted to bring me to space
　before he gets too busy to.」

stage0015_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Does Captain $$ブライト$$ sense too
　that war can't be avoided...）

stage0015_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$リディ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$... please come to the bridge, now.」

stage0015_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's exactly it.
　Recovering the shuttle seems to have
　cost us some time.」

stage0015_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「No mistake.
　You're one of the Marcenas...」

stage0015_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$... you need to stay in your room!
　There's a battle going on outside!」

stage0015_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$オードリー$$
（That man is out there...）

stage0015_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Are you scared, $$オードリー$$...?」

stage0015_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...Come with me, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0015_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Where are you planning to go?」

stage0015_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$オードリー$$
「$$バナージ$$... that white mobile suit
　has your biometric data registered...
　only you can operate it, right?」

stage0015_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「We can still get away now.
　Go back to Industrial 7, get on a
　cargo ship, and hide out in another side.」

stage0015_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I'll figure out how to dispose of that unit.」

stage0015_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$オードリー$$
「It has to be done...
　That thing is dangerous.
　It can't be handed over to anyone.」

stage0015_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$バナージ$$
「How can I decide anything if I'm told nothing!
　It's unfair to make people obey like that!」

stage0015_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...What do you want to do?」

stage0015_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Not what you have to do, but what
　you yourself want, tell me that!」

stage0015_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$クェス$$
「See, Ensign $$リディ$$?
　Just like I said.」

stage0015_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$クェス$$
「Heh... I just had a feeling, so I came.
　Figured you two were up to something.」

stage0015_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$.
　You just asked her what she wants to do, but...」

stage0015_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$リディ$$
「Right now, isn't the one thing you
　need to do protecting the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$?」

stage0015_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Even with the Guard mobilized,
　no notable results to show...」

stage0015_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I have no excuse to offer...」

stage0015_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（Give me a look like that,
　and you don't need to say what you mean）

stage0015_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「But, $$ハマーン$$, Your Excellency...
　the Colonel is certain that the Princess
　is aboard that ship」

stage0015_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I see...
　so that's why you couldn't corner
　that ship, is what you're saying」

stage0015_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「But if the key and the Princess are together,
　the Sleeves' target is decided」

stage0015_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel says he'll let that ship run free」

stage0015_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「From documents the $$ガランシェール$$ unit seized,
　it turns out that Gundam can only be moved
　by one specific registered pilot」

stage0015_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So he'll let the key and its pilot run free,
　to confirm whether $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ truly
　meant to hand the box over to us」

stage0015_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Meanwhile... the Princess is in enemy hands」

stage0015_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「At least, judging by that ship's movements,
　they don't seem to know the Princess's identity」

stage0015_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「True enough...
　if they knew, they'd surely have
　taken the Princess hostage by now」

stage0015_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So, the reason you sent this transmission
　is that you want the $$ガランシェール$$ unit
　to mark that ship, is it?」

stage0015_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's right, Captain $$ジンネマン$$.
　The rest I leave to you」

stage0015_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Use the chance to rescue the Princess,
　and if possible, capture the key and its pilot」

stage0015_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Then, I wish you a good fight」

stage0015_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Being wished luck with a look like that...」

stage0015_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$フラスト$$
「The Personal Guard's attitude is nothing new,
　but it still gets my blood boiling」

stage0015_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Sorry, Captain.
　The $$ガランシェール$$ unit gets stuck with the trouble」

stage0015_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm used to that kind of role by now」

stage0015_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then, let me ask you again, rescue the Princess」

stage0015_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「To you, who lent a hand to our revenge,
　I feel personally indebted, Your Excellency.
　I will see the Princess's rescue through」

stage0015_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll expect great things」

stage0015_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「What will you do from here, Your Excellency?」

stage0015_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll go back to $$アクシズ$$.
　Once he learns of this whole affair,
　even the Commander will finally move」

stage0015_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$フラスト$$
「If that happens, the Personal Guard will quiet down」

stage0015_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The Red Comet's return...
　is that day finally here...」

stage0015_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll make it happen.
　For the Spacenoids' long-held wish too」

stage0015_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（Yes... that is the Spacenoids' wish,
　and it is my wish too...）

stage0015_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「You saved us, Captain.
　If the $$ラー・カイラム$$ had arrived even a bit later,
　it would have been the end」

stage0015_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No need to worry about that, Deputy Chief.
　The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ would've beaten the enemy alone」

stage0015_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Well done, Captain $$オットー$$.
　I'll hear the full report later」

stage0015_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$...!
　Why are you here...!?」

stage0015_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「Your son was on the same shuttle as me.
　He got along well with my daughter too」

stage0015_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So that's how it was...」

stage0015_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「We were meant to meet again at L3,
　but this surprised even me」

stage0015_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$オットー$$
「Deputy Chief, the shuttle repairs are done,
　but what would you like to do?」

stage0015_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「Our destination is the same.
　$$クェス$$ and I will stay aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$
　and head for L3 as we are」

stage0015_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「Your son should do the same, Commander」

stage0015_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「You two have finally been reunited.
　Better to have even a little time together」

stage0015_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「Besides, I have my daughter with me too.
　She'll be glad to have him along as well」

stage0015_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Understood.
　I'll do just that」

stage0015_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then, Commander $$ブライト$$...
　the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will return to duty」

stage0015_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「About that, Captain $$オットー$$...
　the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will also attend the L3 ceremony.
　I already have Commander $$レディ・アン$$'s approval」

stage0015_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ブライト$$
「While the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ was down on Earth,
　our mobile suit forces here took heavy losses.
　Your escort is partly meant to fill that gap...」

stage0015_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$オットー$$
「You think something will happen
　at Neo Zeon's joint exercise...?」

stage0015_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I hope it's needless worry,
　but caution never hurts」

stage0015_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$オットー$$
「Understood.
　Then, once the shuttle launches, the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　will escort the $$ラー・カイラム$$ and head for L3」

stage0015_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'll send unused units from the $$ラー・カイラム$$
　over to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
　Have your own pilots operate them」

stage0015_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What is it, $$ハサウェイ$$?」

stage0015_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Now that I think about it, this is the first time
　I've seen Dad at work... I was just thinking...」

stage0015_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I never meant for you to see me
　in the middle of an emergency like this...」

stage0015_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Communications Room ～

stage0015_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「...So, I'm to stay here
　and keep watching the Unicorn from the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$?」

stage0015_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Just tell Londo Bell you're continuing
　the combat test. Since it's proving useful in battle,
　that should suit them just fine too」

stage0015_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I still think it'd be more certain
　to analyze the unit at Von Braun...」

stage0015_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$マーサ$$
「That's the safeguard $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ himself set up.
　One careless move, and there's a real chance
　all the data could be wiped clean」

stage0015_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$マーサ$$
「If that happens,
　the box's location stays hidden forever」

stage0015_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Then it's more certain to keep watch
　on the boy that man chose as the key's pilot」

stage0015_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$マーサ$$
「You'll stay aboard the ship as you are,
　and keep watching the Unicorn」

stage0015_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then I'd like you to bring Londo Bell in too,
　and set up a system of cooperation...」

stage0015_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$マーサ$$
「The fewer people who know the secret, the better...
　You have the $$エコーズ$$ under your command now,
　so make good use of them」

stage0015_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh... I'll be expecting good news」

stage0015_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「What have I done... to end up like this...」

stage0015_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$...
　you...」

stage0015_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work out there, Master $$リディ$$.
　You really shone this time」

stage0015_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Cut it out, $$ＡＧ$$.
　...Or are you just trying to console me?」

stage0015_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...!
　Using your own machine as a shield to protect
　Master $$バナージ$$ isn't something just anyone can do!」

stage0015_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good news for you, Master $$リディ$$.
　That new variable unit loaded on the $$ラー・カイラム$$...
　It seems it'll be entrusted to you, Master $$リディ$$」

stage0015_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$リディ$$
「New type... don't tell me, the $$デルタプラス$$...!?」

stage0015_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe that was the name, yes」

stage0015_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$リディ$$
「But if it's deployed,
　I'd think $$カミーユ$$ or Captain $$アムロ$$ should fly it...」

stage0015_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「From what I heard,
　both Master $$カミーユ$$ and Master $$アムロ$$
　refused to pilot that unit」

stage0015_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$リディ$$
「I don't quite get it, but this is a chance...!
　If I'm given the $$デルタプラス$$,
　I'll wipe out today's disgrace!」

stage0015_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Not knowing can be a happy thing...」

stage0015_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, nothing...
　I'll do my best too, so I don't lose
　to Master $$リディ$$ today... Business, business!」
